scope: Build the pinned HSE course catalogue independently of the private archive. Preserve all published addresses and all local Obsidian originals.

review.fixtureBoundary: All 54 source-math tests ran and passed with the local course archive. The public projection skips only the three notebook-body cases; the same suite still runs its 51 other tests. The separate HTML test checks every catalogue entry whether the archive is present or not.
review.rootProjection: Built from current worktree files with both HSE archive paths, the local Originals directory and the withheld Berkeley slide excluded. On Node 25.2.1 and pnpm 11.25.0, 2,089 pages built; 800 publication tests passed (13 local evidence tests skipped), 339 built-output tests passed, 91 site tests passed (three local notebook tests skipped), and no internal links broke. Coverage and topic checks passed. This is a local projection, not a checkout of a new public branch or an exact CI toolchain reproduction.
review.catalogue: Compared all 67 rendered article bodies with the build from the full worktree, and independently checked titles and pinned targets against the local import manifest. The upstream GitHub tree contained all 67 target blobs. All 67 English aliases use the canonical route. The browser followed the course index to Sem09 Trees and its English alias at 375 and 1280 CSS px; the source link, notice and layout were verified.
review.pagesProjection: The same archive-free copy built 2,089 pages under /bookvar (891,260,684 bytes, below the configured 1 GB limit). Internal link check reported zero broken routes, fragments or files. All 67 titles, pinned targets and prefixed English alias destinations were checked again in this artifact.
review.remaining: The HSE archive is already tracked. This change does not remove it from the Git tree or history, confirm redistribution rights, or deploy a release. The isolated public projection omits the archive explicitly.
